abstract: Since Quasi-Cyclic LDPC (QC-LDPC) codes have many advantages for fast encoding, they are adopted in channel coding of the Chinese Digital Terrestrial Television Broadcasting (DTTB) Standard. The construction of QC-LDPC codes in Chinese DTTB standard, which is based on the structure of RS codes with two information symbols, is described. Also, three fast encoding circuits are presented, which encode in serial, parallel and partial parallel, respectively. They have speeds and complexities that differ with each other. According to the requirements of the system, one of them can be chosen carefully.

articleTitle: Another derivation process of belief propagation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Generally, soft decoding of low-density parity-check codes can be implemented by iterative decoding based on belief propagation (BP) algorithm. In this paper, the BP algorithm is presented and derived in a way which differs from that by Gallager, which helps to understand iterative decoding of LDPC codes more clearly.

articleTitle: T-S Fuzzy-Model-Based Impulsive Control of Autonomous Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Based on their Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model, a new impulsive control method to control smooth nonlinear systems is proposed. The author gives a strict mathematical foundation containing some assumptions on which a nonlinear systems can be expressed as T-S fuzzy model and the followed analysis can proceed, and then proposes some methods and procedure for designing impulsive control laws, which can stabilize the original nonlinear system.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of NCO of Modulation Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: In this paper I bring forward a way to design numeric control oscillator (NCO)that can be used in amplitude modulation, frequency modulation, phase modulation and digital up converter(DUC). Emphatically, this paper analyses characteristics of frequency control word (FCW) and propose solution of different application. Finally a FPGA implementation is presented.

articleTitle: Development of a lumped constant type optical modulator in the microwave band for digital terrestrial TV broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: This article describes development and construction of an evolutional lumped constant type LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> optical modulator that operates via a faint signal in the microwave frequencies for TV program transmission of terrestrial digital TV broadcasting with a bandwidth of 6-9 MHz. This modulator modulates a light beam at 1.5 mum with OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplex) signals at a 6-7 GHz band and a voltage level of 60 dBmuV from a receiving antenna. Performance was satisfactory.

articleTitle: Neural Conjuncted Polynomial's Structure Adaptive Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Based on the analysis of linear conjuncted polynomial filter and the characteristic of single layer neural network with mild nonlinear and severe nonlinear distortions, novel conjunction's structure equalizer is proposed in this paper, and adaptive algorithm is deduced by the normalized least mean squares (NLMS). Computer simulations show that not only the novel type structure equalizer is simpler in structure and but also can availably remove nonlinear distortions and intersymbol interference (ISI), improve performance of bit error rates (BER) no matter what linear channel or nonlinear channel in digital communication systems.

articleTitle: An intercarrier interference mitigation technique with SSC and ASF in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Frequency offsets in regular OFDM communication systems distort the orthogonality between sub-carriers, which results in inter-carrier interference (ICI). In order to combat the impact of ICI on OFDM systems, an ICI mitigation technique by jointing symbol shift cancellation (SSC) and adjacent sub-channel filter (ASF) is proposed in this paper. At first, the symbol shift cancellation method is used to cancel the impact of ICI on the far sub-carriers, and then the adjacent sub-channel filter method is used to cancel the impact of ICI on the adjacent sub-carriers. By analyzing the distribution of the adjacent inter-carrier interference, a pilot-symbol scheme is proposed to improve the accuracy of channel estimation and simplify the adjacent interference filter method. The proposed algorithm can achieve trade-off between the bandwidth efficiency and the complexity of ICI cancellation method. Simulation results show that the technique proposed in this paper can effectively improve BER (Bit Error Rate) performance of the OFDM system.

articleTitle: An Analytical Approach to Incremental Floorplanning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Incremental modification and optimization is of crucial importance in order to cope with the complex design with the merging of VLSI design phases and facilitate concurrent optimization. To handle the incremental floorplanning efficiently, we propose an analytical method in this paper based on a mixed integer linear programming model. Our method supports incremental changes on an existing floorplan and can find an optimal solution with some design constraints. Different with traditional heuristic methods, our algorithm can incorporate metrics into mixed linear programming constraints conveniently and easily. Experiments on MCNC benchmarks show the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, our method can also provide other tools with good physical estimates and other performance guidelines.

articleTitle: A 5.8-GHz omnidirectional horizontal radiation pattern antenna for wireless communication system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: A new kind of planar antenna for wireless communication system is presented in this paper; the antenna is characterized with ominidirectional horizontal plane radiation pattern, compact structure and low profile. It can be used in UMTS or used as small indoor base station antenna. The simple structure of this antenna is based on the conventional small loop antenna. Four printed dipole antennas each with a microstrip via-hole balun feeding structure and two triangular mental plates are combined and fabricated on a substrate. The feeding line of the antenna is etched on the other side of it. Both simulated and measured results exhibit good performance of low un-roundness of horizontal plane omnidirectional radiation pattern.

articleTitle: A Novel Incremental Floorplan Algorithm for Duplication in Integration of High-level Synthesis and Floorplan
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: With VLSI advancing into deep submicron technology stage, interconnection delay has been the dominated aspect of timing issues. In this paper, we contrive a duplication method in high-level synthesis for interconnect delay optimization and present a new incremental floorplan algorithm integrating high-level synthesis with floorplan for exerting those duplication schemes. The new algorithm has been proved by experiments significantly decreasing the total wirelength and the critical path wirelength over the initial results with a linear time complexity. At the same time, the area has increased slightly and the area usage is even improved.

articleTitle: A closed-loop STTD scheme using limited feedback unitary precoding for MIMO-OFDM-OSTBC system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: In this paper, we present a closed-loop STTD scheme using limited feedback unitary precoding for MIMO-OFDM-OSTBC systems, which supports different numbers of transmit antennas. The simulation results show that adopting the STTD scheme in MIMO-OFDM-OSTBC system can obtain higher diversity advantage. Compared with other STTD schemes, the proposed scheme is more flexible in practical application, allows a tradeoff between feedback rate and system performance, and has good upgrading ability of supporting the systems with different numbers of transmit antennas.

articleTitle: Transmission adaptation for MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Different transmission schemes have different diversity and multiplexing tradeoff characters. Adjusting MIMO transmission scheme according to channel quality indicator (CQI) or channel state information will improve system performance. This paper proposes a new transmission adaptation solution depending on two-dimensional channel quality indicators with the aim to enhance system throughput performance. This is realized by using different transmission schemes, which support different data streams. We first implement our algorithm in single carrier MIMO system and then extend it to MIMO-OFDM system with practical correlation scenario. Simulation results show significant throughput gain compared to conventional fixed transmission schemes and conventional adaptation technique.

articleTitle: An efficient PAPR reduction method in MIMO-OFDM systems by jointly frequency-block operations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method to reduce the peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of multicarrier signals in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems by jointly frequency-block operations. Our design improves the performance and framework flexibility (compatible with both space-time and space-frequency patterns) of PAPR reduction in MIMO-OFDM system, which utilizes additional degrees of frequency freedom. Especially, this proposed design can be freely combined with many good-featured space-time or space-frequency coding to achieve better whole system performance, which is unlike the previous typical methods strictly based on space-time block coding structure with relative low data rate. Simulation results show that the good performance is achieved by our novel design.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Reed-Muller Extraction
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: A novel algorithm is proposed to detect a function whether it can be implemented by Pure Reed-Muller (PRM) logic or not in this paper. Compared with those published algorithms, the proposed algorithm has no limitation of the number of input variables and can finish judgment and give PRM expression at the same time. The result of testing under MCNC benchmarks shows our algorithm works well and can simplify some functions largely by expressed as PRM.

articleTitle: Bistatic SAR Imaging Based on Range-Doppler Algorithm Without Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Imaging approach based on range-Doppler algorithm for monostatic SAR is extended to bistatic case. Because of that the transmitter and receiver are located separately, the range cell migration phenomena of bistatic SAR is more complicated than that of monostatic case. In this paper, a simple method of range cell migration correction is used instead of interpolation operation in traditional range-Doppler algorithm for monostatic SAR. Point scatter response, range and azimuth resolutions are also discussed. The simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: A new cluster head assignment algorithm for low energy clustering communication protocols in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: One of the most important issues in wireless sensor network is the energy efficiency of the clustering communication protocols. In clustering communication the more cluster heads are assigned, the more energy is consumed between the cluster heads and the base stations. On the other hand, if we select a small number of cluster heads, the data aggregations increase and so does the total distance between the cluster heads and the others. Obviously, the energy consumption will then increase. In this paper, we focus on the assignment of cluster heads in clustering communication protocols such that the energy consumption of a wireless sensor network is minimized and the lifetime of the network is maximized. In the proposed cluster heads assignment algorithm, an optimal number of nodes which have higher residual energy level are assigned in a round. Experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm. It is shown that that the lifetime of sensor network using this algorithm is longer than the existing methods.

articleTitle: The design of constant current source of high-power Semiconductor laser diode based on ADuC812
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: A design of digital-controlled constant current source for a high-power semiconductor laser diode based on ADuC812 is described. The constant current source used a high-power MOSFET as the current control device and a Hall current sensor as the feedback device of the sample current. The over-current protection circuit and median filter arithmetic in software are designed to ensure stability and safety of laser diode operation. The practical application indicates that the constant current source is safe and reliable to the laser diode, with the linear control of the output current ranged from 0 to 50 Ampere and the 0.1- ampere precision.

articleTitle: A multi-user multi-beam selection scheme based on orthonormal random beamforming for mimo downlink system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: This paper investigates multi-user scheduling with limited feedback of partial channel state information for MIMO downlink system based on orthonormal random beamforming (ORBF). It already shows that ORBF could reduce feedback information remarkably at the same time the throughput is asymptotically optimal and scale as DPC. However ORBF yields severely degraded performance with low to moderate number of users. In this work, we present a multi-user multi-beam selection scheme based on ORBF. The core idea is to feedback more channel information for the group of users identified by ORBF so that much more sum-rate could be achieved even with low number of users. We analyze equal power allocation and adaptive power allocation among beams respectively. Simulation results show that substantial gain could be achieved at the expense of more feedback channel state information and more complexity at the transmitter.

articleTitle: Joint power distribution algorithm for multi-user downlink of JT MIMO system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: For the downlink of MIMO TDD/CDMA mobile radio systems Joint Transmission(JT) which has low receiver complexity is recently proposed. First investigations concerned linear transmitter algorithms and nonlinear transmitter algorithms based on the principle of Tomlison-Harashima Precoding(THP). The nonlinear transmitter algorithms studied by M. Meurer have preferable energy efficient but restricted by coding complexity. In this paper we present a power distribution algorithm in multi-user downlink of linear JT in MIMO system (JT MIMO). First, a model of JT MIMO downlink and interference is introduced, then, we present a joint power distribution algorithm for JT MIMO downlink. By distributing the transmission power of users rationally, under achieving the SINR, minimizes the total transmitted power.

articleTitle: An improved 2-D ESPRIT Method for joint DOA-delay estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: For the purpose of estimating DOAs and delays of multipath signals, a novel improved 2-dimensional (2-D) ESPRIT is proposed. The improved method estimates the joint space-time signal subspace firstly. Then FFT and deconvolution is done to map time delay parameters into frequency phase shifts and a modified joint signal subspace is constructed. At last DOAs and delays are estimated by using rotational invariance property. Compared with traditional 2-D ESPRIT method, the method we proposed here can prevent the correlated noise problem when FFT is done to estimated channel directly. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the improved method.

articleTitle: A multi-user multi-beam selection scheme based on orthonormal random beamforming for mimo downlink system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: A new algorithm for fast direction-of-arrivals (DOAs) tracking of multiple scattering sources is presented in this paper. The proposed method is based on total least square-ESPRIT (TLS-ESPRIT) and subspace updating. Compared with the DOAs estimation algorithms for sources without moving, our technique do not need search and it can update the moving scattering sources parameters fast and exactly. In addition, it can be applied to scenarios with multiple scattering sources that may have different angular power densities. The simulation results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Partial generalized synchronization theorem of discrete systems with applications in encryption scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: This paper presents a theorem for designing controller to make two independent (chaotic) discrete systems realize directional partial generalized synchronization (PGS). A non-symmetric encryption scheme is introduced based on the theorem. One numerical simulation example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed theorem and the encryption scheme. The scheme is able successfully to encrypt and decrypt original information without any loss. The analysis of the key space, sensitivity of key parameters show that this scheme has sound security. The key space of the encryption scheme is larger than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">68</sup>. It can be expected that our theorem and encryption scheme provide new tools for understanding and studying PGS phenomena and information encryptions.

articleTitle: High-level Power Estimation with Improved Entropy for Considering the Temporal Correlated Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: The traditional entropy is an efficient method for high-level power estimation, but it doesn't work when the input signals are temporal correlated, as is always the case for video and audio streams. In this paper, we put forward an improved definition of entropy for the application of power estimation to take into account the temporal correlated signals. The theoretical proofs and the benchmark experimental results verified the efficiency of our algorithm on both the accuracy and the time complexity.

articleTitle: The Influence of Random motion Errors on Bistatic SAR Resolution
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: In order to assess the quality of the system, this paper analyzes the effects of phase errors due to random motion on the resolution of airborne bistatic SAR. For zero mean random motion errors, an analytical result of RMS (root mean square) resolution is derived. Based on the derived model, Gaussian function is found to be the optimum weighting function on azimuth processing and the best achievable RMS resolution is obtained in closed form.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Optimization System of Span Filter Rule Based On Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: One of the drawbacks of content-based filtering technology is that the system cannot adapt the filter to identify emerging spam characteristics. This paper describes the design and implementation of a spam filtering rules optimization system by introducing BP neural network. It can automatically extract features from incoming emails and "learn" so as to modify the filtering rules to accommodate new changes. We compare the performance of our system with spam assassin. Our experiment results show that the accuracy rate reaches 98.65%.

articleTitle: Research of a novel management method in Ethernet Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: Ethernet passive optic network(EPON) is a novel optical access network technology, deploying point to multi-points structure, passive transmission on fiber, supplying service on Ethernet.. It is a new technology is considered one of the best solution of access network. We have proposed a novel management method of EPON system based on SNMP .In this paper, we further deploy the detail of the novel method of TT-ERCR .The experiment results show that the method is effective to the EPON system.

articleTitle: Joint congestion and medium access control in cooperative vehicular ad-hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: In this paper, we address the congestion and medium access control (MAC) problem for cooperative vehicular ad-hoc networks (VANETs) in the framework of utility function maximization. Compared to its counterpart in a wired network where link capacities are assumed to be fixed, congestion control in a multi-hop cooperative VANETs is much more complex and requires joint optimization at both the transport layer and the MAC layer. This is due to the fact that the attainable function value on each path in the network is "elastic" which results in typically non-convex (non-concave) or non-separable function of the transmission attempt rates. A new cross-layer algorithm is proposed to solve the system problem with constraints that arise from the cooperation among the users and contention for the wireless channel access. The algorithm works at the MAC layer to adjust link persistence probability and at the transport layer to adjust flow rates jointly, and it is designed in distributed manner that is amenable to on-line implementation for VANETs. We prove rigorously that the proposed algorithm converges to the globally optimal solution.

articleTitle: Crosstalk Minimization Method for System-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: The crosstalk caused by the coupling capacitance is a major source of load and delay faults in ultra-deep submicron system on chip. In this paper, a crosstalk minimization design for the system-on-chip is presented. We first use a divide-and-conquer method to rearrange wire-segments such that the coupling length can be minimized. Next, the space between adjacent tracks is adjusted by using a quadratic programming method. We have implemented the proposed design on the AMBA-based SoC platform and provided experimental results to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of MIMO JT schemes based on energy effciency
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: For the downlink of multi-user MIMO joint transmission (JT) schemes is proposed, which can be classified as receiver (Rx) oriented. Firstly, we introduce a generic multi-user MIMO JT downlink transmission model. Up to now most research work focuses on linear signal processing algorithms, such as TXZF, TXMF and TXMMSE. In what follows we do compare the above three algorithms based on energy efficient and BER criterion. Simulation results prove the feasibility of linear TXZF algorithm in multi-user MIMO JT downlink.

articleTitle: A 5.8-GHz omnidirectional horizontal radiation pattern antenna for wireless communication system
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Communications, Circuits and Systems
abstract: A long PN code sequence estimation and synchronization algorithm by subsection technique is proposed in this paper. Making use of the separability of response vector h(t) , estimation and synchronization of PN sequence can be made within each subsection. Then the recovery of the whole long sequence can also be simply reconstructed. What need to be dealt with are those smaller dimension blocked matrixes only, and computational complexity is largely reduced. Computational analysis shows that the subsection technique for long PN code sequence estimation does not lose the precision and SNR tolerance at all.
